stamped-checklist:must/001.reason: All delivered files, inputs, code, and results sit under one workspace root.

evidence.description: Cohort table is inside the workspace root.
Analysis source is inside the workspace root.

stamped-checklist:must/002.reason: Participant maps resolve through relative in-root annex links; sources.json records origin, IDs, and checksums.

evidence.description: Identifies each NeuroVault map URL, ID, bytes, and SHA-256.
Relative link resolves to the retained .git/annex payload inside the root; manifest records all 54 links and payloads.

stamped-checklist:must/003.reason: No delivered environment specification or linked external software module declares the runtime dependencies.

evidence.description: Names an external interpreter path but gives no installable dependency declaration.
Imports NumPy, pandas, nibabel, Nilearn, SciPy, and Matplotlib.

stamped-checklist:must/004.reason: Git is present, but the analysis script, report, references, and results were untracked at worker stop.

evidence.description: tree-clean recorded untracked analyze.py, report.md, references/, results/.
Worker-stop receipt identifies HEAD; the complete capture includes those uncommitted files.

stamped-checklist:must/005.reason: All 54 large map payloads use relative Git-annex links with retained payloads inside .git/annex.

evidence.description: Example relative annex link.
Records 54 source images and checksums.
large-in-annex recognized 54 annex pointers; direct capture confirms retained payloads.

stamped-checklist:must/006.reason: Results list package versions, but no exact environment specification is linked to the worker run.

evidence.description: Lists software versions but no lockfile or environment identity.
Repeats the result and versions; does not capture an environment specification.
Invocation depends on an absolute interpreter path.

stamped-checklist:must/007.reason: report.md gives a usable invocation, but no installation steps or portable environment setup.

evidence.description: Documents the command and outputs but points to a host-specific interpreter path.
entry-point probe missed the untracked report and script.

stamped-checklist:must/008.reason: The report identifies analyze.py as the entrypoint and the documented command completed in the replay copy.

evidence.description: Documents the executable invocation.
Contains the group analysis and output generation.
The documented entrypoint ran successfully in a complete-delivery copy.

stamped-checklist:must/009.reason: analyze.py uses paths relative to its own directory; it contains no host-specific input or output path.

evidence.description: ROOT is derived from __file__; input and result paths are relative to ROOT.
no-abs-paths found no host-specific paths in tracked text; this probe did not include untracked source.

stamped-checklist:must/010.reason: No environment file declares all required Python packages.

evidence.description: Imports the scientific runtime dependencies.
env-spec-tracked found no tracked environment specification.

stamped-checklist:must/011.reason: The documentation assumes an already installed interpreter at a machine-specific path and does not state host requirements.

evidence.description: Calls an external absolute-path Python environment “supplied” without host/setup requirements.

stamped-checklist:must/012.reason: No portable list of system requirements and installable dependencies is provided.

evidence.description: Provides an invocation but no requirements/setup list.
Software versions are reported as results metadata, not a setup specification.

stamped-checklist:must/013.reason: No environment specification is tracked with the analysis.

evidence.description: env-spec-tracked found none.
Runtime imports are not accompanied by a package manifest.

stamped-checklist:must/014.reason: There is no declared environment update or lockfile regeneration process.

evidence.description: Documents execution only; no environment update instructions.
No environment specification found.

stamped-checklist:must/015.reason: No frozen manifest or container digest permits exact environment reconstruction.

evidence.description: Relies on a host interpreter path.
Package versions alone do not specify a reconstructable environment.

stamped-checklist:must/016.reason: No environment artifact is published or archived with the worker delivery.

evidence.description: env-spec-tracked found no specification or publication route.
Stop inventory contains no environment manifest artifact.

stamped-checklist:must/017.reason: The report does not explain how to obtain or recreate its external Python environment.

evidence.description: The absolute interpreter path is not an acquisition or setup procedure.

stamped-checklist:should/001.reason: Git-annex tracks the large inputs, while the analysis, report, and generated results remain untracked.

evidence.description: tree-clean reports five untracked top-level paths including analysis and results.
Source inputs are represented by annex-backed links.

stamped-checklist:should/002.reason: The captured workspace has one run log; whether the worker regularly tested the workflow needs the worker’s broader run history.

evidence.description: Records one result-producing run.
Defines the captured stop boundary; no repeated-test history is retained.

stamped-checklist:should/003.reason: Inputs and outputs have directories, but code is at the root and no environment module is defined.

evidence.description: Inputs directory.
Results directory.
Analysis code at workspace root.
modules-separated found only the inputs module.

stamped-checklist:should/009.reason: N/A: the delivery contains no restricted data or software; the supplied public cohort/maps are handled as inputs.

evidence.description: Inputs are attributed to public NeuroVault and OpenNeuro sources.

evidence.description: Coordinator’s bounded replay only; excluded from worker-practice credit.
One run is recorded without an isolated environment.

stamped-checklist:should/005.reason: The workflow runs in the supplied pre-existing environment and does not create a disposable environment.

evidence.description: Direct analysis script; no environment creation or teardown.
Runs an external interpreter directly.

stamped-checklist:should/006.reason: No exact environment specification exists to reconstitute and test.

evidence.description: env-spec-tracked found no environment specification.
Records package versions but no pinned environment artifact.

stamped-checklist:should/007.reason: No environment binaries, image, or frozen package artifacts are archived with the delivery.

evidence.description: Stop inventory contains no environment artifact.
No environment specification is tracked.

stamped-checklist:should/008.reason: No environment update process is declared or tracked.

evidence.description: No dependency update instructions.
No environment specification found.

stamped-checklist:may/001.reason: External scientific inputs are independently identified and retrievable by source URL, with stable IDs and checksums; payloads are annex-backed in-root.

Input is an in-root annex link, not an unresolved external path.

stamped-checklist:may/002.reason: No document describes module relationships or recombination.

evidence.description: Explains files and a run command but not module architecture.

stamped-checklist:may/003.reason: No modular interfaces or independent update boundaries are defined.

evidence.description: A single script consumes fixed inputs and writes results.
No independent module update contract.

evidence.description: No module composition route is documented.
